package middleware

import (
	"net/url"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
)

func TestScratchEmptyBalancersReturnNil(t *testing.T) {
	rb := NewRandomBalancer(nil)
	assert.Nil(t, rb.Next(nil))
	rb2 := NewRandomBalancer([]*ProxyTarget{})
	assert.Nil(t, rb2.Next(nil))

	rrb := NewRoundRobinBalancer([]*ProxyTarget{})
	assert.Nil(t, rrb.Next(nil))
	rrb2 := NewRoundRobinBalancer(nil)
	assert.Nil(t, rrb2.Next(nil))

	// targets exist -> unchanged behavior
	u, _ := url.Parse("http://127.0.0.1:1234")
	t1 := &ProxyTarget{Name: "t1", URL: u}
	t2 := &ProxyTarget{Name: "t2", URL: u}
	rb3 := NewRandomBalancer([]*ProxyTarget{t1, t2})
	for i := 0; i < 20; i++ {
		got := rb3.Next(nil)
		assert.True(t, got == t1 || got == t2)
	}
	rrb3 := NewRoundRobinBalancer([]*ProxyTarget{t1, t2})
	assert.Equal(t, t1, rrb3.Next(nil))
	assert.Equal(t, t2, rrb3.Next(nil))
	assert.Equal(t, t1, rrb3.Next(nil))

	// removal down to empty then Next -> nil (no panic)
	assert.True(t, rrb3.RemoveTarget("t1"))
	assert.True(t, rrb3.RemoveTarget("t2"))
	assert.Nil(t, rrb3.Next(nil))
	assert.True(t, rb3.RemoveTarget("t1"))
	assert.True(t, rb3.RemoveTarget("t2"))
	assert.Nil(t, rb3.Next(nil))
}
EOF
